title: One small click for man - one giant click mankind
author: Morganafreeman
selftext:
Edit: yes I know i messed up the title.

Ok, turns out im bad with titles. BUT I've been building something for the last few weeks and I'd love some people from here to break it/try it/give me some feedback.  
  
It's called OneSmallClick. The whole idea is that there's only one probe, and everyone in the world is flying it to Mars together. Its inspiration I took from randomly thinking about cookie clicker and the big reddit button if anybody remembers that. Every click from every player pushes the same probe. No separate saves racing each other, just one shared mission with a live arrival date.

Here is what the game has:

\- Your own idle side: upgrades that boost how much thrust you add, and it keeps pushing while you're away (capped at about 8 hours, so no one can AFK their way to Mars alone)

\- Thrust balances itself as more people join. Each leg is meant to take about a month whether it's 10 of us or 10,000

\- The signal has to be kept alive with a daily ping. If the crew lets it lapse, the probe drops into safe mode. That's a setback, never a wipe

\- The crew votes on what happens next. After Mars you all pick where we go (Ceres or Vesta first...)

\- Player and country leaderboards, medals for the crew, passport stamps for every stop

\- 16-bit SNES-style pixel art, because I love space and I love that look

Its very early days and I have so much more planned, to be honest, i'd love to release a fleshed out idea on steam with characters and maybe a more individual game progression rather than world wide progression, but I wanted to see how this would do!

Would genuinely love feedback, especially on the upgrade balance and whether the pacing feels right for an incremental. Be brutal, I can take it (probably).

[https://onesmallclick.naveessharma.workers.dev/](https://onesmallclick.naveessharma.workers.dev/)
